 US midterm election results: Democrats have swept the US Congress, securing seats well above the majority mark in both the House of Representatives and the Senate. US midterm election results LIVE: Democrats have now seized control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate, taking charge of the US Congress in a major setback for President Donald Trump. As results became clearer, Trump earlier in the day, spoke to CBS News and congratulated Democrats on their victories saying that the two sides will work things out for the final two years of his term in office. “Otherwise, I'd just veto everything,” he said. ...Read More 
 Results for key US Senate seats: Michigan: Democratic Abdul El-Sayed wins
 Alaska: Counting of votes yet to begin
 Texas: Democrat James Talarico wins
 Kansas: Democrat Adam Hamilton wins
 Maine: Democrat Troy D Jackson wins
 Iowa: Democrat Josh Turek wins
 Nebraska: Independent candidate Dan Osborn projected to win
 Ohio: Democrat Sherrod Brown wins
 South Carolina: Democrat Annie Andrews wins
 Meanwhile, Hakeem Jeffries is poised to make history as the first Black speaker of the House after Democrats achieved sweeping victory, according to AP. All 435 seats of the House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 Senate seats went to polls on November 3, Tuesday. Congress: House of Representatives + Senate | In numbers House of Representatives – Total seats: 435 Current standing: Republicans hold 218 seats, Democrats 214, an Independent with Republicans, and two vacant seats. Majority mark: 218 seats Senate – Total seats: 100 Seats contested in midterms: 35 (33 regular elections, 2 special elections) Current standing: Republicans hold 53 seats, Democrats hold 45 along with two Independents Majority mark: 51 seats What are midterms and what do they decide? The midterm elections are held in the middle of each four-year presidential term. However, by definition, they do not involve the president. They can be an opportunity for voters to grade the president’s policies and performance by his term’s first two years. The midterm results will decide which political party – Republicans or Democrats – would control the Congress and how easy it would be for the President to carry out his policies and plans. Key issues in midterms While the ongoing war between Iran and the United States is a major focus, the American economy remains a significant issue for voters in the midterm elections. Immigration is another major issue as Trump’s Republican administration runs a tight ship. Trump’s trade policies, healthcare, and his leadership would also play a key role in the midterms. Trump’s spirits US President Donald Trump closed the midterm campaign with an address from the Reflecting Pool and spoke about how midterm results often go against the sitting president’s party. Earlier, he also revealed his plans in case Democrats win the Congress. He had said he would become “Mr Veto” and “veto everything.” 
 Follow all the updates here: Nov 4, 2026, 14:39:56 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Susie Lee wins Nevada District 3 House seat
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Susie Lee has won the election to the US House of Representatives, representing Nevada's 3rd Congressional District. She defeated Republican Marty O'Donnell, the Associated Press reported.
 Nov 4, 2026, 14:35:40 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Tina Kotek wins Oregon governor race
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Tina Kotek has been re-elected to the Oregon governor's office after she defeated Republican Christine Drazan, the Associated Press reported.
 Kotek defeated Drazan for a second time; the two had also faced off in 2022.
 Nov 4, 2026, 14:22:39 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Tight race in fight to lead Los Angeles City Hall
 US midterm election results LIVE: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass and fellow Democrat Nithya Raman were locked in a tight race in early returns as votes are still being counted, the Associated Press reported.
 The outcome will determine whether the nation's second most populous city will follow New York's lead, where democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani was elected mayor last year.
 Nov 4, 2026, 14:03:01 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Republican Pete Ricketts wins Nebraska Senate seat
 US midterm election results LIVE: Republican Pete Ricketts has won the Nebraska Senate seat, defeating Independent candidate Dan Osborn. Ricketts will now serve his first full six-year term, after his 2023 appointment to replace Republican Senator Ben Sasse and 2024 special election victory, the Associated Press reported.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:55:40 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Katie Hobbs wins Arizona governor race
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Katie Hobbs has been re-elected to the Arizona governor's office in the US midterm election after she defeated Republican Andy Biggs, Republican Gertritrude Gonzalez and Republican Alice Novoa, according to the Associated Press.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:45:40 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Xavier Becerra wins California governor's race
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Xavier Becerra defeated Republican Steve Hilton to win the election to the California governor's office. He will take over from California governor Gavin Newsom as the next governor.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:43:25 IST US midterm election results LIVE: French minister says Trump remains in charge of foreign policy after Republicans' defeat
 US midterm election results LIVE: French finance minister Roland Lescure said on Wednesday that President Donald Trump remains in charge of foreign policy as he reacted to Republicans' defeat in the midterm elections.
 "Either he decides to rise above the fray — acknowledging that changes are necessary, particularly regarding gasoline prices, which directly affect people — and, I might add, he tones down his international involvement; or he does not," Lescure told French TV channel BFM.
 "Frankly, this is something we will need to keep an eye on in the coming days," he added.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:34:20 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Republican Jim Pillen wins Nebraska governor race
 US midterm election results LIVE: Republican Jim Pillen has won the re-election to Nebraska's governor's office, defeating Democrat Lynne Walz.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:32:55 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Republican Kurt Alme wins Montana Senate seat
 US midterm election results LIVE: Republican Kurt Alme has won the Montana Senate seat, defeating Democrat Alani Bankhead and Independent Seth Bodnar, according to the Associated Press.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:20:29 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Republican Pete Ricketts to win Nebraska Senate seat, projects Decision Desk HQ
 US midterm election results LIVE: Republican Pete Ricketts is projected to win the Nebraska Senate seat, according to Decision Desk HQ.
 According to the Associated Press' figures, Ricketts is leading in the seat with a margin of over 5 per cent.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:10:14 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Mary Peltola trails in Alaska Senate race
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Mary Peltola, who was earlier in the lead, is now trailing behind Republican Dan S. Sullivan in the race for Alaska's Senate seat, according to the Associated Press.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:08:02 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Keith Ellison wins re-election for attorney general in Minnesota
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Keith Ellison has won re-election to the Attorney General's office in Minnesota, according to the Associated Press.
 Nov 4, 2026, 13:02:47 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Abdul El-Sayed jibes at Trump after winning Michigan Senate seat
 US midterm election results LIVE: After winning the Michigan Senate seat, Democrat Abdul El-Sayed jibed at US President Donald Trump. He said, "Donald, look, I know you struggled with my name. So after JD (Vance) swears me in January, you can just go on and call me Senator."
 Nov 4, 2026, 12:59:08 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate seat
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed has won the Michigan Senate seat, defeating Republican Mike Rogers, reported the Associated Press. He has also made history by becoming the first Muslim to be elected to the US Senate. 
 Nov 4, 2026, 12:56:39 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Which party has won how many seats in House of Representatives so far?
 US midterm election results LIVE: Even as the vote-counting process is underway, Democrats have so far won 224 seats in the House of Representatives, well above the majority mark of 218. Meanwhile, Republicans have secured 134 seats, according to the Associated Press.
 Nov 4, 2026, 12:47:19 IST US midterm election results LIVE: 'Guess my election interfering space lasers didn't work', says Musk
 US midterm election results LIVE: Billionaire Elon Musk shared a cryptic post on Wednesday, seemingly reacting to the losses of Republicans in the US midterm elections in which Democrats flipped several seats.
 “Guess my election-interfering space lasers didn’t work this time,” Musk, who had appealed for voting “Red” on Tuesday, said on X.
 Nov 4, 2026, 12:34:21 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Richard Pan wins California District 6
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Richard Pan won the election to the US House representing California's 6th Congressional District, according to the Associated Press.
 Nov 4, 2026, 12:20:55 IST US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Jocelyn Benson wins Michigan governor race
 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Jocelyn Benson has won the election as governor of Michigan, defeating Republican John James, according to the Associated Press. This means that the governor's office will remain under Democratic control in the swing state.
 Nov 4, 2026, 12:08:27 IST 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Hakeem Jeffries set to make history as first Black speaker of House, reports AP
 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Hakeem Jeffries is set to make history as the first Black speaker of the US House after Democrats' sweeping victory, the Associated Press reported.
 Nov 4, 2026, 11:56:19 IST 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrats take US Congress, calls AP
 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrats have taken the US Congress from Republicans, securing a majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate, according to the Associated Press.
 Nov 4, 2026, 11:53:41 IST Michigan election result LIVE: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed to win Michigan Senate seat, projects Decision Desk HQ
 Michigan election result LIVE: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed is projected to win the Michigan Senate seat, according to Decision Desk HQ.
 Nov 4, 2026, 11:48:06 IST 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Troy Jackson wins Maine Senate seat
 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Troy D. Jackson has won the Maine Senate seat, defeating incumbent Republican Susan M. Collins. Democrats reportedly considered defeating Collins as a key part of winning control of the US Senate.
 Nov 4, 2026, 11:44:28 IST 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: 'We just took back Texas,' says Talarico after major victory
 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat James Talarico delivered a victory speech after winning the Texas Senate seat. He said the Democrats have taken back Texas.
 “We are tired of being told to hate each other,” he told the crowd, adding that, "we didn’t win this race by alienating our neighbours or shaming our neighbours.”
 He said his campaign is changing the game to a "politics of love."
 "This win is for every Texan who ever wondered if anyone is ever listening. I heard you. We heard you. And tonight, the world hears you," Talarico added, AP reported.
 Nov 4, 2026, 11:40:09 IST 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Ilhan Omar wins Minnesota District 5 House seat
 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Democrat Ilhan Omar has won the Minnesota's 5th Congressional District in the US House, defeating John Nagel by a margin of 60 per cent votes, according to the Associated Press reported. 
 Nov 4, 2026, 11:31:59 IST 2026 US midterm election results LIVE: Barack Obama reacts to poll outcome, says 'Americans sent a clear message'
 2026 US midterm election results: Former US President Barack Obama reacted to the incoming results and said the American people "sent a clear message." He said the citizens want politics that does not divide people.
 In a post on X, Obama said, "Tonight, the American people sent a clear message — they want a politics that brings people together rather than divides them, and leaders who offer concrete solutions to the challenges they face."
 He said that such results were possible only because Democratic candidates stepped forward in every region of the country. He also expressed gratitude to election officials.
 "While this administration has another two years in office, our job now is to roll up our sleeves, make changes wherever we have the power to do so, prevent further damage, and lay the groundwork for the future," Obama added.
